mapper.select: SELECT a.account_id, a.username, a.nickname, a.avatar_url, dci.create_time AS check_in_time FROM daily_check_in dci INNER JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dci.account_id WHERE a.status != 3 AND (a.is_deleted = 0 OR a.is_deleted IS NULL) ORDER BY dci.create_time DESC, dci.check_in_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
